Ari (People Ops): Heads up — handbook updated today with a couple of related changes: Travel & Commute Stipend rules and the Certification Reimbursement flow. Please read the section here: https://redwood.internal/handbook/comp-stipends. TL;DR: commute stipend moves to monthly auto-pay for eligible hybrid employees; travel per-diem caps adjusted; certification reimbursements now require completion of the Compliance Fundamentals training and e-sign attestation. Managers: please confirm eligible headcount in the tracker by Fri 2026-04-03. Employees: complete the training + e-sign the attestation before submitting reimbursements. Spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/handbook-stipends. Submission form: https://redwood.internal/forms/stipend-claim. Quick command if you want current team export: `hr_tools export-team --team <team-name> --format csv`

Devon (Eng Manager): Quick q — are retroactive claims allowed? Someone had travel last month and forgot to file.

Ari (People Ops): Retroactive claims OK up to 60 days from the expense date. Use the submission form and in the notes field put "retro-claim" and tag @Samir (Finance) for approvals. After 60 days, escalate to me for exception review.

Samir (Finance): Receipts: PDF or clear photo preferred. For non-USD invoices, include the bank conversion rate or use XE on the date of the transaction and paste the conversion in the form. GL code for travel/stipends: 6302-TRV. For certifications (reimbursable): use 6401-EDU. CC finance@redwood.ai on approvals if over $500.

Priya (IC): Are EU folks on a separate cap / per-diem? Wondering about VAT reclaim too.

Ari (People Ops): Good Q — EU: per-diem caps are in EUR (see the "intl" tab in the sheet). VAT reclaim depends on the receipt and vendor; finance will attempt reclaim where allowed but employees should keep original VAT invoices. If VAT can't be reclaimed we reimburse gross per the EUR cap. If you hit a borderline case, mark the form "intl-vat" and @Samir will triage.

people-ops-bot: Form submitted by Priya (IC) — travel-stipend-form — ts=2501234575

Lena (Hiring Ops): If headcount changes after the Fri cutoff (offer accepted / start date shift), can we update the tracker?

Ari (People Ops): Yes — update the tracker and add a manager approval row, then ping me. We will process mid-cycle exceptions once a week for any post-cutoff changes.

Devon (Eng Manager): Confirming — I updated my team list (added two contractors marked as ineligible). Also — certification cap per person is still $1,200/year, right?

Ari (People Ops): Correct: $1,200/year standard cap per employee for courses/certs. Exceptions (higher-cost certs, company-required L&D) can be approved by me + finance on a case-by-case basis — include justification in the form.

Priya (IC): I’ll finish the Compliance Fundamentals training today and e-sign the attestation. Thanks!

Devon (Eng Manager): :thumbsup:
